---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest new rendering support or a new capability for viewmd
title: ""
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## What would you like viewmd to do?

A clear description of the feature or new Markdown/Mermaid support you're asking for.

## What's the use case?

What are you trying to view, and why doesn't viewmd handle it today? Concrete input you'd want to
render is more useful than an abstract description — paste a `.md` snippet if you have one.

## Proposed behavior (optional)

If you have a rough idea of what the rendered output should look like, sketch it here (an ASCII
mockup is great for terminal output).

## Alternatives considered

Any workaround you're using today, or other tools that handle this.

---
*This tracker is for discussion. If accepted, a maintainer writes it up as a `VIEWMD-NNNN` issue
under [issues/](https://github.com/mo6/viewmd/blob/main/issues/README.md) — with testable
requirements and a Definition of Ready acceptance — before any implementation starts. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/mo6/viewmd/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) if you'd like to
implement it yourself.*
